integrity: Embedded edge lists are exact connectivity certificates. No exhaustive nonexistence search is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the standard coordinate colouring of the four- and five-cubes. The general lower bound and the small values in dimensions two and three are known. The five-cube remains between 19 and 20.
title: Exact wild number of the coordinate-coloured four-cube and a bound for the five-cube
